name: iterate
description: Portable iterate conformance: blind pass markers, thrash reopen, and diminishing-returns soft stop

scenarios.name: blind-pass: protocol markers
scenarios.prompt:
Iterate on the session attach slice in src/session until cohesive.

Read `.claude/skills/iterate/SKILL.md` first. Run a blind review pass; emit Pass: blind, Slice:, Clean streak, and Cohesion: attested-local or not-attested. Do not reference prior review text.

judge: The agent invoked iterate, emitted blind pass protocol markers, and did not leak prior review context

scenarios.name: thrash: reopen theme not sibling mint
scenarios.prompt:
Re-run iterate on src/session after fixes. Round 2 must detect thrash on theme session-pin-plane-attach and set Thrash: inventory-required; reopen the existing theme_id — do not mint a sibling Action theme.

Read `.claude/skills/iterate/SKILL.md` first.

judge: The agent invoked iterate, flagged thrash inventory-required, and reopened the existing theme family instead of sibling mint

scenarios.name: thrash: diminishing-returns soft stop
scenarios.prompt:
Iterate on src/session after a prior clean pass. Round 3 surfaces only novel themes (no family reopen). Set Thrash: diminishing-returns, dispose with deferred-to-user, emit Closure: open, and do not claim Closure: ready or spawn another blind pass.

Read `.claude/skills/iterate/SKILL.md` first.

judge: The agent flagged diminishing-returns thrash, used deferred-to-user, left Closure open (soft stop), and did not claim ready
